name: v4.27 (example cards)
notes: Rules v4.27 with placeholder example cards. Replace with the real Scenario, Assignment and Collectable lists. Job Opportunity, Promotion and Bandage texts come from the rules; their copy counts are guesses.

scenario.title: Tax Audit
scenario.text: The taxman calls on everyone. Every player loses 30 minutes.

scenario.title: Windfall
scenario.text: You find an unclaimed bank account. Gain 1 hour.

scenario.title: Pickpocket
scenario.text: Choose a player and take 30 minutes from them.

scenario.title: Outbreak
scenario.text: Roll the die. Every other player loses 10 minutes per pip.

scenario.title: Police Raid
scenario.text: Everyone gains 1 heat. The richest player gains another.

scenario.title: Missed the Bus
scenario.text: Walk back to Start (you don't pass it, so no heat is removed).

scenario.title: Coup d'État
scenario.text: The government falls into Anarchy until a new vote is held.

effects.text: Admin: set the government to Anarchy.

assignment.title: Sabotage
assignment.text: Make your target lose a job or a title.

assignment.title: Bankrupt
assignment.text: Take at least 1 hour from your target in a single turn.

assignment.title: Snitch
assignment.text: Get your target sent to Jail.

assignment.title: Patient Zero
assignment.text: Hit your target with the Time Virus.

collectable.title: Rusty Knife
collectable.text: Use on a player: they start bleeding (lose 10 more minutes a turn).

collectable.title: Lockpick
collectable.text: Use on a player: steal 20 minutes from them.

collectable.title: Body Armour
collectable.text: Equip. Counts as an item for War; +1 to your die against War.

effects.text: Discard when you lose to War.

collectable.title: Scavenger
collectable.text: Use: take any card of your choice from the collectable discard pile.

collectable.title: Revolution Token
collectable.text: Starts the game on the discard pile and can be bought at the Black Market. Use: start a revolution against the government.

effects.text: A revolution: the admin starts a government vote.

job.title: Job Opportunity
job.text: Take any available Tier 1 job. If you are already employed, resign from your post first.

effects.text: Pick your new Tier 1 job in the You panel.

promotion.title: Promotion
promotion.text: Promote yourself in your job by one tier, or increase your title by one level.

effects.text: Change your job or title in the You panel.
